title: Hofmann, Grof and Ruck's reported plan for a new Eleusis

tellings.quote: think you know Albert Hoffman who discovered LSD Stannislav Grath and Carl Ruck >> all maybe this is a rumor but I think they wanted to create a new elusis and

plain: Michels says that three men who studied psychedelic drugs wanted to create "a new Eleusis": the chemist Albert Hofmann, who discovered LSD, the psychiatrist Stanislav Grof, and the scholar Carl Ruck. Eleusis was the site of a secret religious rite in ancient Greece, so the idea would be to bring back something like that sacred ceremony in modern form. Michels tells it himself, without naming a source, and adds that "maybe this is a rumor."
